_source: Applicable translations adapted from jtasks 6caa1413da4f5246a06e5b7e22bbc3f10e437b65; MIT, see LICENSE.
help.lang: --lang <tag>: the language of the answers (en, pt-BR, ...); also JTASKS_LANG, then JLOCK_LANG
help.json: --json on any action: the answer in JSON; --run <id> picks the run
detail.execution: validate and operations preview prepare intent. import creates runtime state. run --run <id> owns the foreground controller; run it again to resume a stopped run. stop explicitly retires owned work. Exit 3 means unfinished/intervention.
detail.monitoring: status, read, watch, logs, operations status and the local dashboard read persisted facts only. Closing a watcher or browser never dispatches, stops, repairs or refreshes work. --json keeps English fields, identifiers and reason codes.
detail.operations: Plans explicitly choose judgment completion and none/task/group/final/mixed operation placement. Only declared initial checks are selected by the controller; workers select repairs. revision plus operations inputs-changed explicitly invalidates relevant checks; general operation inputs are not automatically fingerprinted.
detail.autonomy: Autonomous execution is the default; run --restricted or profile autonomy=restricted opts in to questions/answers. Native permissions are not an OS sandbox. Resource overrides require actor/reason and never stop an old process or authorize duplicate attempts.
detail.cleanup: clean --run <id> --json previews an exact historical inventory. Only explicit clean --approve <file> --yes applies an unchanged reviewed inventory; incomplete history also requires --discard-resume. Active/uncertain custody blocks cleanup. No automatic history deletion.
detail.checkpoint: Declare checkpoint.paths as exact files within group/final operation inputs. A passing check never commits. checkpoint review is read-only; checkpoint apply requires the unchanged review, clean import baseline, relevant passing checks on the admitted scoped bytes and positive retirement/empty custody proofs. Uncertain Git/SQLite intent blocks cleanup and needs explicit inspection/reconciliation.
detail.estimator: The optional estimator skill runs separately after slicing, with Python 3.10+, the independent CLI and a configured fresh harness. It fills only missing estimates. Buffered output has a post-exit 1 MiB acceptance limit, not a memory cap; a finite deadline requests tree termination but escaped helpers remain unobserved. No provider turn or run starts implicitly.
